name: Felt-Tip Iris
summary: Iris Haze with Amble's own icons, drawn like a fat felt-tip pen: bold round strokes, each icon with one dab of apricot. The green flag is a "go" chevron on a stubby pole, stop is a soft octagon, and the category markers are rings around their own glyphs. The purple turns a little further, greys take a touch more lilac, and corners get a little rounder.
